description: Use when benchmarking total spend in a software category against same-size peers. Returns median monthly spend, p25/p75 band, and sample size for any software category by company size. Example: Mid-market CRM spend median ~$3,500/mo, p75 of $4,900 — organizations above p75 have a negotiation mandate supported by market data. Source: Stratalize enterprise spend composite. $0.10 USDC per call.
name: get_category_spend_benchmark
